title: Call & Consultation
description: Call for a free in home estimate. We listen first: to your wishes, your needs, and how you actually use the space.

title: Design & Planning
description: We work through layout, materials, and budget together, so there are no surprises once work begins.

title: Construction
description: Meticulous attention to detail at every phase, with open, honest communication on progress the whole way through.

title: Final Walkthrough
description: We finish on schedule and within budget, then walk the finished space with you to confirm it matches what you envisioned.
